name: Dr.Anjali Swaroop
review: I can see the OPD queue and patient details together, so it’s easier to know what needs attention next.

name: Dr.Jyoti Chaurasia
review: Having a patient’s history in one place makes it much easier for our team to pick up where the last visit left off.

name: Dr.Vipeen Raut
review: The prescription templates save us from repeating the same details, and the final copy is clear for patients to follow.

name: Dr.Shilipa Raut
review: It’s much simpler to check medicine stock when the inventory is part of the same system we use every day.

name: Dr.Kautilya Swaroop
review: Bills, receipts, and installment payments are easier to follow when they’re all linked to the patient’s record.

name: Dr.Tarun Pandey
review: We can shape the workflow around our specialty, instead of asking the team to change the way they work.

name: Dr.Sindhuja Pandey
review: Sending consultation details by email or SMS makes it easier for patients to keep the information they need.

name: Dr. Lalit Singh
review: It helps to have appointments, notes, and follow-ups connected, rather than scattered across different tools.
